# List Style Type

::: tip 实现进度 90% · 已完成
活示例对标 Amis List Style：`list-none` / `disc` / `decimal` 改 `list-style-type`，`list-inside` / `outside` 改 `list-style-position`。独立样例 + 组合；`m:` / `pc:` 已进 helper。
:::

列表标记。类打在 `<ul>` / `<ol>` 上，不是 `li`。外面圆点要留 `pl-5` 才看得到。`type: tpl` 里写 HTML 列表才会生效。Vamis schema `className` 打在外层 `div.vamis-node`；本页用 HTML 岛把类打在列表上。

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `list-none` | `list-style-type: none;` |
| `list-disc` | `list-style-type: disc;` |
| `list-decimal` | `list-style-type: decimal;` |
| `list-inside` | `list-style-position: inside;` |
| `list-outside` | `list-style-position: outside;` |

## list-none

`list-style-type: none`。标记拿掉。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-none pl-5">
      <li>没有圆点</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-none pl-5">
      <li>没有圆点</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

## list-disc

`list-style-type: disc`。外面圆点，要留 `pl-5` 才看得到。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-disc pl-5">
      <li>圆点</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-disc pl-5">
      <li>圆点</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

## list-decimal

`list-style-type: decimal`。


## list-inside

`list-style-position: inside`。标记走进内容盒。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-disc list-inside pl-5">
      <li>inside 标记在行内</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-disc list-inside pl-5">
      <li>inside 标记在行内</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

## list-outside

`list-style-position: outside`。默认档，标记在盒子外。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-disc list-outside pl-5">
      <li>outside 标记在外面</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="list-disc list-outside pl-5">
      <li>outside 标记在外面</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

## 组合

同一组：`list-disc`、`list-decimal`、`list-inside`。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-start">
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <ul class="list-disc pl-5">
        <li>disc</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <ol class="list-decimal pl-5">
        <li>decimal</li>
      </ol>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <ul class="list-disc list-inside pl-5">
        <li>inside</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-start">
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">

    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">

        <li>decimal</li>
      </ol>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <ul class="list-disc list-inside pl-5">
        <li>inside</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
```

## 响应式设计

支持通过添加设备前缀 `m:` 或者 `pc:` 来分别针对「手机端」或者「pc端」设置样式，更多说明请前往[「辅助类-响应式设计」](/style/responsive-design)。窄屏 `m:list-none`；桌面 `pc:list-disc`。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="m:list-none pc:list-disc pl-5">
      <li>m:list-none pc:list-disc</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <ul class="m:list-none pc:list-disc pl-5">
      <li>m:list-none pc:list-disc</li>
      <li>两项</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
```

## 状态前缀

本页与 Amis 一样：不支持[「状态前缀」](/style/state)。helper 源码写了 `// hover ?` 但没有做。

其它 helper 见 [辅助类-响应式设计](/style/responsive-design)、[辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
